name: Barishal
registryAssessment: Bangladesh's official Ministry of Land map.land.gov.bd viewer is a public mouza-and-plot-based digital land zoning map. Its current page explicitly lists বরিশাল সদর (Barishal Sadar) among the areas noted by the service. This evidences an official public map/service relevant to the city, but not complete cadastral coverage or legal title records.

queries.query: Barishal Bangladesh official cadastral map land parcel GIS land records map
queries.result: Found official Bangladesh sources: the Ministry of Land map viewer, the DLRS/Settlement online land-record and survey portal, Survey of Bangladesh map services, Barishal City Corporation, and an official LGED Barishal map directory. The map.land.gov.bd page describes digitized and georeferenced mouza/plot maps and lists Barishal Sadar in its service notice.

queries.query: বরিশাল বাংলাদেশ সরকারি ভূমি মানচিত্র জমি রেকর্ড অনলাইন
queries.result: Found the official Bengali Ministry of Land map viewer and DLRS/Settlement portal. The map viewer describes mouza- and plot-based national digital land zoning, provides বিভাগ/জেলা/থানা-উপজেলা/মৌজা/সিট/প্লট selectors, and names বরিশাল সদর in its current notice. The DLRS portal identifies the official Barishal zonal settlement office and related survey services.

officialSources.role: Ministry of Land public mouza/plot map viewer
officialSources.observation: HTTP 200. Page describes digitized/georeferenced mouza maps, exposes plot and mouza selectors, and lists Barishal Sadar among areas in the service notice. The page's JavaScript identifies an OpenLayers/GeoServer backend and plot geometry route.

officialSources.role: DLRS online land-record and survey portal
officialSources.observation: HTTP 200. Official portal states it displays draft-stage khatians from ongoing surveys and directs completed surveys to land.gov.bd; it is not itself proof of citywide parcel-vector availability.
Search result identifies the official Barishal zonal settlement office covering Barishal district, Pirojpur and Jhalokathi, plus survey/map services.

geometryDecision.reason: No safe anonymous full parcel polygon response was obtained. The official viewer exposes plot geometry through a GeoServer backend and POST routes, but the GIS host returned HTTP 503 and no bounded geometry-only response was available to retain.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official national mouza/plot digital land-zoning viewer with Barishal Sadar named in the current service notice.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official viewer presence and Barishal Sadar service mention verified; exact WUP-point parcel inclusion, complete city coverage, cadastral/legal status, and public vector response were not verified.
